name: Invisibubble: Scroll Timer
oneLiner: A floating bubble timer for Android. Set your minutes before you start scrolling, and a full-screen takeover tells you when time is up.
summary: Invisibubble: Scroll Timer is an Android app that keeps a small floating glass bubble at the edge of your screen, over other apps. You set a scroll timer before you start scrolling, and when time is up a full-screen takeover asks if you are done or want extra time.
timeUp: A full-screen takeover asks "I'm done" or lets you add extra time.
extensionRule: The second extension needs a typed reason.
reminders: Same-day reminders show only as a coloured ring on the bubble, while the bubble is on. There is no reminder notification.
hideBubble: A "Hide bubble" option hides the bubble for a chosen time.

offers.name: Lifetime unlock
offers.label: lifetime unlock (one-time)
offers.description: One-time payment that unlocks the app for life.

offers.name: 24-hour pass
offers.label: for a 24-hour pass (can be bought again)
offers.description: Unlocks the app for 24 hours. It can be bought again.

freeFirstDayText: New users currently get their first 24 hours free. No code is needed.

facts.label: What it does
facts.value: A small floating glass bubble stays at the screen edge over other apps. You set a scroll timer before you start scrolling.

facts.label: Account needed
facts.value: No. There is no account or sign-in.

facts.label: Data
facts.value: App data is stored in private storage on the phone. {{app.sdkClaim}} See https://nofa-apps.store/privacy-policy/

facts.label: Affiliation
facts.value: Not affiliated with YouTube, Instagram, Google or any other brand

facts.label: Health claims
facts.value: None. Invisibubble is a timer, not a medical or health product.

permissions.label: Display over other apps
permissions.reason: Lets the bubble float on your screen while you use other apps. It draws the bubble. It does not let Invisibubble see, read or record what happens inside other apps.

permissions.label: Run in the background
permissions.reason: Keeps the bubble and a running timer active when the app is not in the foreground. Recent Android versions require the second permission for this. Android shows a visible notification while this is active.

permissions.label: Notifications
permissions.reason: Used for the alert that a free day or 24-hour pass has ended, and for the ongoing notice Android shows while the bubble is on. We do not send marketing notifications.

permissions.label: Exact alarms
permissions.reason: Used so the alert that a free day or 24-hour pass has ended arrives at the right time.

permissions.label: Restart handling
permissions.reason: Lets the app re-schedule the alert that tells you a free day or 24-hour pass has ended, so it still arrives after the phone restarts or the app updates. The bubble does not restart by itself after a restart.

permissions.label: Battery optimization request
permissions.reason: Lets the app ask you to allow it to run without battery restrictions, so Android does not stop the bubble. You choose, and you can say no.

permissions.label: Keep awake
permissions.reason: Declared by a bundled overlay library. The app does not keep your phone awake. Android may briefly wake the phone when the alert that a free day or 24-hour pass has ended goes off.

permissions.label: Google Play Billing
permissions.reason: Lets you buy the 24-hour pass or the lifetime unlock, and shows their prices, through Google Play.

permissions.label: Internet and network state
permissions.reason: Used only for the single request described under "Network request", and by Google Play Billing for purchases.

noPermissions: Invisibubble has no camera, microphone, location, contacts, storage or SMS permissions.
extensionReasonPrivacy: The reason you type for a second time extension is not saved or sent anywhere. It is checked once to make sure it is not empty, then cleared.
sdkClaim: No analytics, crash-reporting, advertising or attribution SDKs.
timerRuns: The scroll timer runs only while the bubble is on. When the countdown ends, the bubble shows the "Time's up" screen. There is no notification when a timer finishes.
notificationsFact: Only two: the alert that a free day or 24-hour pass has ended, and the ongoing notice Android shows while the bubble is on.
accessRule: Invisibubble is free to install. Showing the floating bubble, and so the scroll timer, needs a 24-hour pass (Rs 5) or the lifetime unlock (Rs 100). Reminders and Settings open without paying.
openTimer: Tap the bubble to open "Quick actions", then tap "Scroll timer".
tapVsDrag: A tap is different from a drag. Dragging the bubble moves it to the nearest screen edge.
